subject: EMERGENCY: Complete Global Outage across all API regions & Data Corruption
body:
Urgent Pager Alert,

Our entire platform infrastructure is down. Every single API request to https://api.service.com is returning 503 Service Unavailable or connection resets. We are observing potential data loss on our primary clusters.

All tenants and enterprise customer accounts are completely blocked.
Trace ID: tr_global_9941a8e
Environment: Production
Impact: System-wide blackout affecting 100% of traffic.

Please escalate immediately to SRE leads!

Marcus Vance
Head of Infrastructure
